name: adbc
description: Stored credentials and connection details for ADBC drivers. Reference a secret by name with ATTACH's `secret` option, or let URI scope lookup pick it when its scope prefixes the ATTACH path.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: URI prefix identifying the secret's scope. Defaults to `URI` when omitted; a secret with neither is rejected. Set it explicitly to match a different or broader prefix.

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: ADBC driver name (e.g. `'sqlite'`, `'postgresql'`) or path to a shared library.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Connection URI passed to the driver. Driver-specific format.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password. This field is redacted in DuckDB's secret display, not necessarily in SQL logs.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Database name, when not encoded in the URI.

parameters.name: entrypoint
parameters.description: Custom driver entrypoint function name (rarely needed).

parameters.name: extra_options
parameters.description: Driver-specific string options. Values are redacted in secret display. Pass numeric or binary options directly as ATTACH options.

examples.description: Create and use a SQLite secret by name
Omit SCOPE: the secret's URI becomes its scope, so ATTACH finds it from the path
